title: Denied Because of the House: home-purchase mortgages denied for collateral, 2024 HMDA
typicalBuyer: first lien, principal residence, single unit (total_units = 1)

byHomeAndUse.group: Home they will live in, 1 unit
Home they will live in, 2 to 4 units

faq.q: What does it mean when a mortgage is denied for collateral?
faq.a: It means the lender reported the property itself as a reason it would not make the loan. Lenders report it under HMDA as denial reason "Collateral", and Regulation B's sample notice words it "Value or type of collateral not sufficient". The data does not say which: a low appraisal, the condition of the house, or a type of property the loan program will not accept.

faq.q: How often are mortgages denied because of the appraisal or the property?
faq.a: In 2024, 83,247 of 623,942 denied home-purchase applications named collateral as a reason. For a first-lien loan on a single-unit home the buyer would live in, it was a reason in 10.7% of denials that gave reasons, or 15.3 per 1,000 applications decided. Debt-to-income ratio and credit history were cited far more often.

faq.q: Are mortgages on older homes denied more often because of the house?
faq.a: In 2024 HMDA data, yes by neighbourhood: for site-built homes, collateral denials ran at 19.2 per 1,000 applications in census tracts where the median home was 40 to 59 years old, against 9.3 where it was under 20. The overall denial rate barely changed. HMDA records the tract's median housing age, not the age of the house being bought.

faq.q: Can I get a copy of the appraisal if my mortgage is denied?
faq.a: Yes. Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.14) requires a lender to give you a copy of every appraisal and written valuation developed for a first-lien loan on a home, promptly after it is completed or three business days before closing, whichever is earlier, even if the loan does not close. If credit is denied, Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.9) also requires a notice within 30 days, and the statement of reasons must be specific.

faq.q: Where can I download mortgage denial data by county?
faq.a: This study publishes two CSV files under a CC BY 4.0 licence: every county and every state, with 2024 home-purchase applications, denials and the count of denials citing each reason, for first-lien loans on single-unit homes the buyer would live in. The underlying data is the public FFIEC HMDA data browser, which needs no key.
